description: Build workflow JSON from a named preset in list_templates without executing it. For restyle, pass image and style in params; returns {workflow, recipe}. Other presets return workflow JSON directly. Check get_generation_recommendations before FLUX. Use create_workflow for manual assembly or apply_template for custom template JSON.

params.description: Preset parameters: prompt, width, height, steps, cfg, seed, ckpt_name, etc. For restyle: required image (ComfyUI input filename), style (cartoon, oil_painting, anime, watercolor, sketch, comic, pixel_art, pastel, cyberpunk or free text); optional prompt, denoise, negative_prompt.

template.description: Preset id, e.g. txt2img, txt2img_flux, or restyle

name: build_workflow
